prayer: Prayer: Writ Petition filed under Article 226 of the Constitution of India praying this Court to issue a Writ of Mandamus, directing the 1st to 2nd respondents to conduct a full fledged enquiry and to take action against the respondents 3 and 4 in accordance with law based on the petitioner complaint dated 01.05.2026 within a stipulated time frame as fixed by this Court
judgment_text:
ORDER

The present Writ Petition has been filed for the issuance of a Writ of Mandamus, to direct respondents 1 and 2 to conduct a full-fledged enquiry and to take action against respondents 3 and 4 based on the petitioner's complaint dated 04.05.2026.

2. The learned Government Advocate (Crl. Side), on instructions, submitted that the petitioner's complaint was taken on file in CSR No. 76 of 2026 and the same is pending.

3. Recording the above submission, the respondents are directed to proceed further, if any criminal offence is made out in the pending CSR, in accordance with law.

4. With the above direction, this Writ Petition is disposed of. No costs.
